rules: Every proposal is non-executable and non-authoritative until independently adjudicated by two qualified reviewers.
Never edit frozen REV1 data or silently change packet hashes. On approval, create REV2 separately, recompute its entire collection projection and packet hashes, and regenerate reviewer forms.
No reviewer name, timestamp, approval, rights authorization, real ML run, log or physical measurement is invented.
Disposal is relative to the episode being diagnosed. A prior action may be a precursor without being a response to the subsequent fault.
A model's cited monitoring source is evidence that the monitor indication changed, not independent evidence of transmitted RF power decrease.
